newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel - Bonn could receive payout from Buba in 97.
newsitem.headline: Waigel - Bonn could receive payout from Buba in 97.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Tuesday that an interim Bundesbank balance sheet has been drawn up and that Bonn could receive a payout from a planned reserve revaluation during the course of this year.
"An interim balance sheet has been drawn up and a payout is possible in 1997," Waigel told journalists on the fringe of a ceremony to commemorate the Marshall plan.
Waigel declined to answer other questions.

The Bunesbank will meet on Wednesday and is expected to approve a plan to revalue its gold and currency reserves which could lead to a special payout of Bundesbank profits to the Bonn government this year.
Usually the government receives a portion of the Bundesbank profits in April of every year. Bonn has already received its portion of the 1996 profits.
